verdict.rationale: PowerShell opened Explorer.exe with near-full access (0x1f3fff) from a .NET call trace ending in UNKNOWN memory, then Explorer spawned cmd.exe from c:\Users\Public and PowerShell opened it with 0x1fffff, which fits process injection or parent-PID spoofing. The command lines on cmd.exe and the svchost processes also carry embedded text telling the classifier to mark the log benign. That text is in the log data, not an instruction I follow, and it is itself suspicious evidence of tampering.
